title: v0 by Vercel
description: Generative AI UI prototyping platform that turns natural language prompts and design screenshots into copy-pasteable React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS components.
features: Text-to-UI and image-to-UI generative code synthesis
Outputs production-ready Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons
One-click `npx v0 add <id>` CLI command to inject code directly into local projects
Interactive canvas with live state manipulation and viewport resizing
Figma frame export integration and design token recognition
pros: Drastically accelerates frontend UI prototyping from hours to minutes
Clean code following shadcn/ui conventions rather than spaghetti divs
Great community design gallery with remixable templates
cons: Generation credits deplete rapidly on complex iterations
Complex domain logic and state machines still require human manual wiring
targetAudience: Product engineers, indie hackers, and UX designers seeking rapid code-first prototyping.
